title: Take a past winning ad and regenerate it in Seedance in a new visual style…
content:
Take a past winning ad and regenerate it in Seedance in a new visual style (e.g., Pixar style) using a single prompt to “revive” performance  
One-shot the entire ad in Seedance with a single prompt (no multi-shot prompting)  
Test multiple regenerated visual styles of the same winning ad and let performance data pick the best-performing style (Pixar has been strongest so far)
